yoast.seo_title: Custom House Signs & Address Plaques | Brand 9 Signs
yoast.meta_description: Custom house signs, address plaques & modern name signs in NE Florida — designed & built to last by Brand 9 Signs, artist-led since 1986.

faqs: How much does a custom house sign cost?
It depends on size, material, and complexity — from a straightforward address plaque to a fully custom dimensional name sign. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll give you a clear quote.
Do you make signs for coastal or beach homes?
Yes — we build coastal house signs with finishes and materials chosen to handle salt air and strong sun so they hold up over time.
Every one. Brand 9 is an artist-led shop; your house sign is designed for proportion, material, and finish, not pulled from a catalog.
